lines.zh: 我不用脚走，我浮着过去。
lines.en: I do not walk; I drift forward.

lines.zh: 身下的影子跑得比我慢。
lines.en: My shadow on the ground falls behind me.

lines.zh: 这点高度，对我来说等于散步。
lines.en: This altitude is a stroll to me.

lines.zh: 气垫在脚底，草都压平了。
lines.en: Ki under my feet flattens the grass.
I skim the treetops, looking for hiders.
So much muscle, yet flight feels light.

lines.zh: 我一边飞一边扫视地面。
lines.en: I sweep the ground as I glide.
This planet's gravity is so light.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面飞，留一道白线。
lines.en: I skim the water, leaving a white line.

lines.zh: 风从我肩甲两侧绕过去。
lines.en: Wind splits around my shoulder guards.
I fly low so I can grab you.
Wings? Unnecessary. Ki suffices.
I hover, too lazy to land.
The ki in this crowd is pitiful.
I crack my knuckles.

lines.zh: 任务说得简单，做起来也简单。
lines.en: The job sounded easy. It is.

lines.zh: 我在数这个村里有多少活人。
lines.en: I count the living in this village.
My shoulder guard chafes; I loosen it.
The wind drags my cape back.

lines.zh: 我在想要不要现在就动手。
lines.en: I am deciding whether to start now.
I exhale a plume of white breath.
This rabble is not worth dirtying my hands.

lines.zh: 我把手心的气收了回去。
lines.en: I draw the ki back into my palm.
No one else in the sky. Good.
I look down at my own fist.
Ten more would change nothing.
There is something in your ki.

lines.zh: 抬头说话，我不喜欢俯视。
lines.en: Speak up — I dislike looking down.
You meet my eyes. Rare.

lines.zh: 我在你身上闻到了战斗力。
lines.en: I smell battle power on you.
Do not think I fear to land.
Whose warrior are you?

lines.zh: 我记住你了，你最好值得。
lines.en: I will remember you. Be worth it.
Your hands tremble. I like that.
I do not ask names. Only strength.
You hide your ki well.
I have landed. You should be nervous.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？笑我还没动手？
lines.en: Why laugh? At my patience?
I am in no hurry today.
Your kind, I have seen many.
My fist closes.
Are you finished?
A scrape? You call that injury?
I give a step, then rise again.
It stings. Not enough to make me serious.
This wound only makes my fists heavier.
My ki rises instead of falling.
You hurt me. Good.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看那道口子。
lines.en: I look down at the gash.
I bite down and roll my shoulder back.
Do not celebrate yet.
Food? I am strong without it.
Offer it, and I accept.

lines.zh: 这星球的食物我不认得。
lines.en: I do not know this world's food.
Do not think meat buys your life.
I take it and weigh it.
It is decent — better than field rations.
I swallow it whole.
Your deference is noted.
This is precious to you, is it not?

lines.zh: 我笑了一声，把碗丢回给你。
lines.en: I laugh and toss the bowl back.

lines.zh: 你撞到的是铁一样的身体。
lines.en: You hit a body like iron.
Clear out of my ki trail.
I need not even shift.

lines.zh: 你这点力道算不上推力。
lines.en: That force is not even a nudge.
I nudge you aside with my elbow.
Do not touch my shoulder guard.
You need three steps to steady.
I neither apologize nor explain.
The wake pushed me an inch off line.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就当你挑战。
lines.en: Bump again and I call it a challenge.
Such things hold no interest for me.
Warriors do not discuss this.
You expect me to blush?

lines.zh: 我要的是对手，不是伴侣。
lines.en: I seek opponents, not partners.

lines.zh: 我把手一挥，风都跟着动。
lines.en: I wave a hand; the wind follows.
The one I wait for is in the sky.
I have no use for such softness.
I turn and rise slightly.
Save it.
Whatever lies here belongs to the strong.
I lift a hand; it floats to me.
A crook of my finger saves a stoop.
This ore interests me.
I tuck it under my chest plate.
He dropped it; I can use it.
I glance at it and pocket it.
Everything here is so light.
Worthless, but mine for now.

lines.zh: 拾取这种事，我不亲自做——好吧，这次。
lines.en: I do not stoop for loot. This once.
Locked on. You may move now.

lines.zh: 我要你活着记住这一刻。
lines.en: I want you alive to remember this.
My palm grows hot.
Do not run; running is slower for you.
You have been chosen.
This is an order and a sentence.
Ki gathers at my fingertips.
I smile because you are already losing.
I can see your ki scrambling.

lines.zh: 你把背对向我，是个错误。
lines.en: Turning your back was a mistake.

lines.zh: 这一战有我一个就够了。
lines.en: I am all this fight needs.
Try moving.

lines.zh: 我的残影已经在你身后。
lines.en: My afterimage already stands behind you.
Do not count on escape.
From now, you answer to me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你看，找最薄的一处。
lines.en: I circle, hunting the thinnest guard.
Your weight sits on the wrong foot.
A ki sphere spins in my palm.
I close the gap steadily.

lines.zh: 你想拉开距离，正好给我时间。
lines.en: You want distance — that buys me time.
Your ki is sinking.

lines.zh: 我抬手的动作你追不上。
lines.en: You cannot track my hand.
You guard your chest, so I take the legs.
The afterimage stays; I am on your flank.
One more step and you meet the wall.

lines.zh: 我不用看，也能感觉到你。
lines.en: I need not look to feel you.
The wave is already charging.
Your eyes start to wander.
Three breaths. That is all.
The tenser you get, the easier this is.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，露个假破绽。
lines.en: I turn my body, offering a false gap.
My fist drives down and the ground splits.
I press down from above.
My boot lands on your plate.
My elbow digs into your ribs.
One palm blow sends you flying.
You stop my hand, not my heel.
Three blows, one spot.
I drive you into the dirt.
My fist slips past your guard.
I have your bracer in my grip.
I flood my fist with ki.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，你还笑得出来吗？
lines.en: Can you still smile after that?
My knuckles graze your cheek.
Recover the blow and press again.

lines.zh: 从高空落下来，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I drop from the sky and leave a crater.
I am the one you were waiting for.
I take this sky.
My wake arrives before I do.
I hover and take a slow survey.

lines.zh: 没人能让我落地——除了你。
lines.en: Nothing brings me down but you.

lines.zh: 这地方太干净了，我弄脏它。
lines.en: Too clean here. I will fix that.
My ki presses the dust flat.
Hold your weapon properly.
Do not ask where I came from.
My knees do not bend on landing.
This trip is only a warm-up.
I fling my cape back.
I am Dore. Remember it.
These people are too loud.

lines.zh: 我来之前没打算留活口。
lines.en: I did not plan on survivors.
The wind stopped because I arrived.
Look up.

lines.zh: 火焰烧过我的护甲，烫得刺耳。
lines.en: Flame washes my armor with a hiss.
I hit the ground and crater it.

lines.zh: 水下使不上气，这很难受。
lines.en: Underwater my ki fails me. Unpleasant.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推歪，我稳住身形。
lines.en: The blast shoves me aside; I hold my line.

lines.zh: 一根暗箭扎进我的肩膀。
lines.en: A hidden bolt buries in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 奇怪的咒力钻进骨头里。
lines.en: Strange magic seeps into my bones.
Fighting hungry thins my ki.

lines.zh: 雷击穿了我的护甲，指尖发麻。
lines.en: Lightning pierces my armor and numbs my fingers.

lines.zh: 什么都没有，连气也摸不着。
lines.en: Nothing — I cannot even feel my ki.
